description.value: You're well-versed in the artistic history of your people and found a way to make it your own. You might not even be a musician, but an actor, comedian, or other kind of performer—the fact remains that the show is in your blood, and you're good at what you do. You gain the Virtuosic Performer feat with the specialty of your choice. Your background in entertainment has left you shrewd, and you know exactly how to get a reaction out of a crowd. When you roll Performance to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Earn Income], treat your task's level as 1 higher for the purposes of determining income earned, but don't increase the DC.
